image:image.image:title: HEAR framework for Vision-Sound-Language-Action sound-centric robot manipulation
image:image.image:caption: HEAR reframes robot manipulation from a vision-dominant setting into a sound-causal one.

image:image.image:title: HEAR architecture overview: Historizer, Envisioner, Advancer and Realizer
image:image.image:caption: HEAR processes streaming audio, reasons over multi-sensory context, learns temporal progression, and produces smooth action chunks.

image:image.image:title: Historizer: streaming causal audio memory across the Blind Execution Interval
image:image.image:caption: A streaming stateful transformer maintaining compact causal audio memory across execution gaps.

image:image.image:title: Envisioner: hierarchical omni-modal reasoning for VLA control
image:image.image:caption: Fuses vision, language, proprioception, the current audio window and causal audio memory.

image:image.image:title: Advancer: audio world model predicting near-future audio codes
image:image.image:caption: An audio world model that injects temporal grounding by predicting near-future audio codes.

image:image.image:title: HEAR real-robot demonstration: Moka Coffee
image:image.image:caption: Long-horizon sound-centric process monitoring: the robot must detect the transition into the sputtering phase before pouring.

image:image.image:title: HEAR real-robot demonstration: Answer Phone
image:image.image:caption: Multi-stage progress tracking with ring detection, speech understanding and end-of-call recognition under severe visual aliasing.

image:image.image:title: HEAR real-robot demonstration: Shake Bottle (Empty)
image:image.image:caption: Active acoustic sensing, where perception depends on generating a repeatable motion that elicits a discriminative sound.

image:image.image:title: HEAR real-robot demonstration: Shake Bottle (Occupied)
image:image.image:caption: Whether the policy can use self-generated rattling sound to distinguish occupied from empty bottles consistently across trials.

image:image.image:title: HEAR real-robot demonstration: Real Alarm Clock
image:image.image:caption: Whether the model remains sound-causal under real acoustic domain shift and still avoids the visually tempting early press.
